title: Cirrus Logic and Calumet Specialty Chemicals The last trade
text:
Cirrus Logic and Calumet Specialty Chemicals 
The last traded price for a stock is always the true market value. But, we have also pointed out that the current true market value may also be misvalued. For two stocks, Cirrus Logic ( CRUS ) and Calumet Specialty Chemicals ( CLMT ), our belief is that both are significantly mispriced, both with strong possibilities on being much higher in two years.
Basic financial parameters for Cirrus illustrate how market cheap it is versus others in the sector. For example, Skyworks ( SWKS ) current non-GAAP P/E is $102/$6.5 or 16. QORVO ( QRVO ) is $70/$4.6 or 15. Broadcom ( AVGO ) is $263/$16 or 16.5. Cirrus is $54/$4.9 or 11, which is at least 45% discounted for its peers based on this metric.
It gets more interesting when you compared revenue growth for the last 12 months. Broadcom's revenue grew 33% last year. But Broadcom offered this long-term growth comment, "The Company will continue to target long term annual revenue growth of 5 percent." Skyworks grew 11% . Cirrus' long-term growth model is 15-20% and has averaged such for 10 years. Based on these metrics, Cirrus is extremely undervalued by at least $25.
In truth, Cirrus experiences what financial institutions refer to as the “Apple ( AAPL ) risk discount.” Apple represents approximately 75% of the Cirrus revenue. We believe that is about to change . We expect Cirrus to pick up several hundred million in revenue during the next few years or a dollar or two of additional non-Apple profit. What we do not know is how much additional revenue Apple will contribute in the same period. We understand that Apple is looking at voice recognition, a function that Cirrus just developed. We strongly suspect Apple is one of the interested. This one to two dollar ASP would create an additional $250M -$500M of Apple revenue. We also know Cirrus is working on mics, which again we strongly suspect is targeted at Apple and Samsung ( OTC:SSNLF ). Again this would mean in time an additional $500M revenue from Apple (six mics at $0.35 each). If or when this additional revenue comes is unknown, but possible in the next two to three years.
